name: Stollberg (Erzgebirge, Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided horizontally red over yellow, with the inscription Stollberg Erzgeb. in black on the red and the city arms of Stollberg (a church on yellow above red and blue) at the centre.
history: Municipal flag of Stollberg/Erzgeb.; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Stollberg arms — church on yellow above red and blue
